capability.name: Tantra Authority — digital catalog (courses, books, practice audio)
capability.description: Courses, books, and guided audio on sexuality, relationships, and embodied practice. Instant digital delivery, lifetime access, recoverable access link. The full machine-readable catalog with live price and availability is at the catalog API.

productId.description: A product id from the catalog API.

buyerEmail.description: Where the access link is delivered.

price.note: Each product carries priceCents in the catalog API. Range ~$6.99–$997.

payment.note: EVERY catalog product is agent-payable, no human needed. GET /api/x402/<productId> returns an HTTP 402 with a USDC-on-Base payTo + price; pay the USDC, then retry with header X-Payment: base64({"network":"base","txHash":"0x…","email":"optional"}). Settlement is verified ON-CHAIN (USDC Transfer receipt-checked, replay-guarded) and the real access link is returned. Product ids + USDC prices (priceUsdcAtomic) + per-product x402 URLs are in https://api.tantra-authority.com/api/products. Humans still use Clover checkout.

sla.fulfillment: instant digital delivery by email + recoverable access link

attestations.claim: Published by The Naked Press (DBA of LK Publishing, LLC). Author: Lawrence Lanoff.
Every purchase is backed by a 30-day, no-questions money-back guarantee.

aggregateScore.note: Machine-readable catalog with live per-product price and availability. Reputation accrues from first agent-mediated transactions.
